name: Shark Bait: Riptide
source:
A life's debt must be paid... Can you uncover the weaknesses of the Gods to clear it? Or will you choose to side with them instead?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
欠下的一條命，終究要還……你能找出眾神的弱點，償清這筆債嗎？還是會轉而選擇站到他們那邊？
